mentions.name: Mind the Link
mentions.description: This app is a bookmarking/read-later service where bookmarks are private by default but can be shared publicly, similar to Hacker News. It supports tags, collections, and importing browser bookmarks, and offers a companion Chrome extension.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on https://mindthelink.com, a bookmarking/read-later app. Bookmarks are private by default, but you can share links publicly, a bit like HN. I've added some features lately: tags, collections, importing browser bookmarks, etc.
